integrity: The proof derives the full rank-value cross-covariance matrix from the classical single-coordinate Gini covariance identity and the deterministic rank sum, then restricts it to the centered contrast subspace. Exact rational enumeration for uniform rank allocations and a rational beta-family inequality replay are supplementary checks.
scientific_limitations: The parent distribution must be atomless, nondegenerate, and have finite variance.
The isotropy statement is for deterministic zero-sum linear contrasts; ties and nonlinear or studentized statistics require additional analysis.
A complete text of the closest 1954 historical paper was unavailable, so an equivalent older contrast-space formulation cannot be excluded.
title: All centered rank contrasts share one exact value-correlation
